channel.title: ConfigMaps on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in ConfigMaps on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a ConfigMap
item.description: This section describes how to create a ConfigMap. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the ConfigMap Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has ConfigMap Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Configuration > ConfigMaps in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View ConfigMap List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of ConfigMaps. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the ConfigMap View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has ConfigMap View permissions and enter your workspace. item.title: Edit ConfigMap Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit ConfigMap information. You can edit the alias and description of a ConfigMap. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a ConfigMap. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the ConfigMap Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has ConfigMap Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete a ConfigMap
item.description: This section describes how to delete a ConfigMap. Warning A ConfigMap cannot be recovered after deletion. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the ConfigMap Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Delete a Single ConfigMap Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has ConfigMap Management permissions and enter your workspace.
